Lemma
[An adjustment for the sequences $\epsilon _i$ and $(x_i,t_i)$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0189, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0190 ↗ ctr:chow-iii-pseudolocality-counterstatement 1. ch21:21.12\group Point picking

After shrinking $\epsilon _i$ and replacing the bad point if necessary, one may arrange \[ |\Rm _{g_i}|(x,t)\le \alpha /t+2\epsilon _{0i}^{-2} \] whenever $0<t\le \epsilon _i^2$ and $d_{g_i(t)}(x,x_{0i})\le \epsilon _{0i}$, while retaining a bad point.
